notes.title: Ver.1.0.4 Update (June 25, 2025)
notes.notes:
Update Details:

1. Added "Tips" Button
 A help feature has been added to assist players when they get stuck in the game.
 It allows players to review what they should do next, such as selecting key points, changing the speaker, or adjusting the chronological order of statements.

2. Added Sound Effects to Controller Operations
 Cutscenes now progress automatically without requiring manual clicks each time.

3. Adjusted Certain Visual Effects
 Some video and visual effects have been fine-tuned.

notes.title: [Update Notice] Addition of Text Playback Speed Adjustment and Auto-Play for Cut
notes.notes:
[Update Notice] Addition of Text Playback Speed Adjustment and Auto-Play for Cutscenes

Thank you for playing "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" and for your continued interest in the game.

An update was released today, May 15!

--------------------------------------
[b]Update Details:[/b]

[b]1. Added Text Playback Speed Adjustment[/b]
You can now adjust the "Text Speed" in the settings menu to change the playback speed of in-game text.

[b]2. Added Auto-Play for Cutscenes[/b]
During cutscenes, clicking "Auto" at the bottom right will enable auto-play mode, allowing scenes to progress automatically without having to click each time.

[b]3. Bug Fixes[/b]
Several known issues have been addressed and resolved.
--------------------------------------

These updates reflect some of the most commonly requested features from our players.
We hope you continue to enjoy the game!

And we hope you will continue to support "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders"!

— The "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" Project Team

notes.title: Notice of the Release Date for “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders”
notes.notes:
To everyone who has added "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" to their wishlist—thank you very much.

We sincerely appreciate your patience.

We are pleased to announce that the official release date for "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" has been set for April 24, 2025.

Since the announcement of the delay, we’ve spent about a month polishing and refining the game. At last, we are ready to deliver it to you. We deeply apologize to everyone who has been waiting.

Additionally, we would like to inform you that we have received official approval from SOMI, the developer of the game "No Case Should Remain Unsolved" (Korean title: 미제사건은 끝내야 하니까), which served as a key inspiration for this project. We personally explained the content of our game to SOMI, who kindly gave their consent.

Our project team would like to express our heartfelt respect and gratitude to SOMI, and we will do our utmost to ensure that everyone enjoys this game.

Please bear with us just a little longer until the release on April 24.

— The "Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders" Project Team

notes.title: Notice of Release Postponement of “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders”
notes.notes:
Thank you very much to everyone who has added “Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders” to your wish list.

We have decided to postpone the game release, which was scheduled for March 20, 2025, in order to further brush up the game content.
Since the announcement on March 6, 2025, we have received a lot of great feedback from you all.
In order to ensure that everyone can play the game with peace of mind, we felt the need to further brush up on the game content and made the difficult decision to postpone the release.

We sincerely apologize to those of you who have been looking forward to the release of the game.

We will let you know once the release date has been finalized.
Thank you very much for your cooperation.

From the project team of Kindaichi Mystery Series: The Honjin Murders
